LOW_Guildhall_LadyCroup
Lady Croup is a member of the Ladies Court, one of Nine-Fingers' elite bodyguards and part of the Guild.

Involvement

Croup can be encountered in the Guildhall during Act Three.

Combat

Attacks and actions

 Blindness ( + )

Limit a foe's sight range. It is easier to hit, and the creature will miss more often.

 Attack rolls against it have  Advantage and the foe attacks with  Disadvantage.

 CON Save
 Range: 18 m (60 ft)
 Bardic Inspiration ( + )

Inspire an ally to go beyond their capabilities with your performance. They can add a +1d6 bonus to their next Attack roll, Ability check, or Saving throw.

 Range: 18 m (60 ft)

 Range: Self

Notes

  • Nine-Fingers' bodyguards all have the Thief Rogue passive feature  Fast Hands, even if they are not rogues.
  • Summonable as an ally through  Gather Your Allies variant  Guildmaster Keene's Fixers, if the party completed Aid the Underduke and sided with the Guild.
